During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], the [[First Order]] [[Attack on Aeos Prime|attacked]] an [[Aeosian]] '''village''' as part of its campaign to deny the [[Resistance]] access to former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]] [[Aeos Prime rebel outpost|bases]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Ace Squadron]] [[pilot]]s [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Griff Halloran]] stumbled upon the abandoned village while scouting the planet [[Aeos Prime]]. They were captured by the Aeosians but Xiono managed to broker peace between the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[space station]] and the Aeosians.<ref name="The New World">{{Resistance|The New World}}</ref> Later, the village was [[Orbital bombardment|destroyed]] by the [[First Order]] during the [[Suppression of the Aeos system]].<ref name="The Escape">{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}</ref>
